content: Word {{position}} ({{word}}) is not part of any recovery phrase. Check its spelling.

comment.text: Error under the recovery phrase field of the Recover key dialog when a typed word is not in the recovery word list; {{position}} is the word's number in the phrase (1 to 24) and {{word}} is the word as the user typed it, shown in parentheses. Full sentences: the word is misspelled, ask the user to check its spelling.
